subject: [PATCH v2 2/2] x86/kstack_erase: Use memset64() for large stack fills

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the stack erasure mechanism on x86-64 architectures by using memset64() to fill large spans of memory, which is more efficient than a word-by-word loop. The patch also makes memset64() always inline for noinstr kernels and adds a check to use the generic loop when KMSAN is enabled. This change results in significant performance improvements, with stackleak_erase() becoming 32% cheaper per return to user space and futex wake/wait and Unix socket sendmsg()/recvmsg() ping-pong round trips getting about 6% faster.
